change.desktopPatch: patches/desktop/0020-caret-agents-pet-unmounted.patch - 3 files, all under src/vs/sessions/**; no core chat file is touched
change.whyThisShape: Registering a pet host is what creates the pet: ChatPetWidgetCoordinator.register() activates the entry and activate() calls createPet(), which builds the pet DOM, listeners, timers and accessibility nodes. unregister() only parks an already-created pet on a detached dormant host, so hiding or unregistering is too late - the three sessions call sites have to not register while the easter egg is off.
change.chatView: contrib/chat/browser/chatView.ts ANDs sessions.developerJoy.enabled into the petHostPreferred observable it already supplied (visibility), so a session chat never prefers a host while the easter egg is off.
change.composer: contrib/chat/browser/newChatInput.ts registers the host from an autorun that tracks the setting and clears the registration when it turns off.
change.toggleButton: contrib/chat/browser/newChatWidget.ts mounts the aquarium toggle button only while the setting is on; previously the button was appended and then hidden by CSS, leaving a focusable button and an accessibility node behind.

stillOpen.appsPanel: NOT IMPLEMENTED. The right region is still an empty editor group. This is the pass's first priority and it was not delivered: the base registers the Changes view and the Files views into their own AuxiliaryBar containers and the Terminal view into the Panel container, and a view id can only live in one container, so merging them into one pinned-tab Apps panel means moving those registrations - which is exactly what the single-pane docked-detail machinery (SinglePaneChangesViewPane, dockedAuxiliaryBarController, the visibility-profile store) is built on. The seam I verified as correct for the next pass: place the native Panel part at Position.RIGHT (the panel already supports RIGHT and `workbench.panel.defaultLocation` exists), register a Caret Apps view container there, and move/alias the Changes and Files views into it. I did not start it rather than ship dead tabs or regress the docked-detail behaviour, both of which the instructions forbid.
